thesis: A single ask-side campaign bought $871,964 of $6-strike October calls (84% ask) [FLOW:sweeps] into a 26%-short-float, hard-to-borrow, covering name [SENT:short_float] — latent squeeze fuel — but the empirical edge is negative: the bullish_flow backtest wins 20% (n=5) [HIST:signal_backtest], dealers are long-gamma 30/30 sessions with July max-pain pinned at $6.00 [STRUCT:max_pain], the desk went 0-for-4 directional [AGENT:phase-8], and the debate was disconfirmed (bear 0.75 >= bull 0.55) [DEBATE:residuals]. Watch, not a trade: directional risk skipped, token defined-risk squeeze carry only.

primary.trigger: hold of the $5.95 DP value area / $6 max-pain pin — carry only

fade.trigger: rejection at the $6.28-6.33 DP supply shelf — put-debit counter-trade

invalidation.price: two daily closes below 5.50 (kills long) OR above 6.33 on rising IV (kills range/short)
invalidation.signal: tomorrow's OI does not confirm the $6-Oct build (sweep was a one-off) [OI:biggest_increases], or conviction_matrix flips DIRECTIONAL_LONG->HEDGED_LONG [INSIGHT:conviction_matrix]
invalidation.macro: SPY regime breaks further RISK-OFF (beta 2.31) [MACRO:MarketRegime], or hawkish late-July CPI/FOMC lifts the 10y

structures.note: carry-only token; long $6 (the flow strike, ~$1.29 real) / short $8 (call-OI wall); squeeze lottery into Aug-12; max loss = debit, so an earnings gap cannot exceed it
trend-continuation hedge below the $5.50 gamma-flip toward the $4.61 52w-low; debit (VRP -0.17 says buy, not sell); pairs with the call spread as cheap long-optionality on the range break

tailwinds: [HIST:vrp] VRP -0.17 PREMIUM_BUYING — cheap vol favors the debit legs

catalysts.event: ENVX Q2 earnings (UW 07-30 likely stale; the squeeze trigger)

key_risks: Long-gamma pin (GEX +30/30) + July max-pain $6 cap the breakout the $6 calls need, with no catalyst until ~Aug-12
20% backtest (n=5) + 90d net-bearish premium flow (-$2.0M) + full downtrend below all SMAs — counter-trend long has no edge
26% short float is double-edged: squeeze fuel up, but 49M shares of conviction the stock falls; cheap VRP means the range can break violently either way
